title: Predict service
description: Request rate and latency for the win-probability API, and the model call inside it. Four panels, because a dashboard nobody can read in one screen is a dashboard nobody opens.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Requests per second, by matched route template. The route is the template rather than the path, so a scan for /wp-admin.php lands in `unmatched` instead of making a series of its own.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: The 95th percentile of end-to-end request time. A mean would hide exactly the requests worth looking at.

panels.title: Inference p95 by model version
panels.description: The model call alone, split by the registered version answering. Read next to the panel on its left: when the two move together the cost is the model, and when only the left one moves it is everything around it.

panels.title: Predictions total by version
panels.description: Cumulative answered predictions per registered version. A promotion is visible here as one line going flat and another starting.
